headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs. The Washington Nationals suffered a 3-6 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Phillies' offense.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their teams' lineups and rotations. Sean Sullivan, a left-handed pitcher for the Colorado Rockies, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 5, 2026. Other notable injured players include Ben Brown (Chicago Cubs), JoJo Romero (Milwaukee Brewers), Dalton Rushing (Los Angeles Dodgers), Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks), Shawn Armstrong (Cleveland Guardians), Mitch Keller (Pittsburgh Pirates), and Connor Seabold (Kansas City Royals).

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable deals announced. Seth Johnson, a right-handed pitcher, has been traded to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 4-3 Win Over Brewers**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close matchup, securing a 4-3 victory. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on 1 hit in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall to Cubs in 5-10 Thrashing**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers, securing a 5-10 victory. Michael Busch led the Dodgers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies LHP Sean Sullivan Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left-handed pitcher Sean Sullivan has been placed on the 15-day injured list, retroactive to July 5, 2026. The move comes as the Rockies navigate their current season schedule.

top_news.title: **Johnson Joins Athletics in Trade**
top_news.summary: Seth Johnson, a right-handed pitcher, has been traded to the Athletics. The trade sent RF Colby Thomas to the Philadelphia Phillies.
